If you cancel a court reservation two hours before the scheduled start time, it falls within the late cancellation window. According to Baseline Padel's Booking & Cancellation Policy, members may cancel free of charge only up to six hours before the start time. Cancellations made later than six hours before the session begins, including two hours before, are subject to late cancellation terms, which may include charges or penalties. It is recommended to cancel as early as possible to avoid such fees.

Baseline Padel has a "Child Supervision and Drop-Off" policy that applies to all branches. It ensures that responsibility for a child's welfare is always clearly defined between the parent or guardian and Baseline Padel staff, with no ambiguous handover periods during which nobody is accountable for a minor's whereabouts. The policy covers children under sixteen, including juniors and guests.

This means you cannot leave your 6-year-old unattended at the club while you play. The club requires clear responsibility for the child's supervision at all times. If you want, I can provide more details or check if there are any specific facilities or programs for children during your playtime.
